description: Use when the user specifies a maximum USDC/USDT payment amount rather than an XGR quantity. Call get_xgr_purchase_options first, use payment_assets[].key, collect user-supplied identity and wallet fields, require explicit terms acceptance, and create one live reservation. Pay only when payment_approved=true and next_action=external_crypto_payment; otherwise do not pay.

country_code.description: Two-letter uppercase country code supplied by the user, for example DE.

email.description: Purchaser email supplied by the user. Do not invent it.

max_payment_amount.description: Maximum amount of the selected payment asset the user authorizes. This is USDC or USDT, not EUR.

name.description: Purchaser name supplied by the user. Do not invent it.

payment_asset.description: Exact payment_assets[].key returned by get_xgr_purchase_options, for example usdc_eth. Do not use the display symbol.

safety_margin_bps.description: Conservative planning margin in basis points. Omit to use the default 100 bps.

sender_wallet.description: User-controlled wallet that will send the stablecoin payment on the listed payment chain. Required when the selected payment asset has requires_sender_wallet=true.

terms_accepted.description: Set to true only after the user explicitly accepts the purchase terms. Never infer or invent acceptance.

xgr_wallet.description: User-controlled XGRChain wallet that will receive the purchased XGR.

name: create_xgr_purchase_order_by_budget

data.description: Structured result data returned by the XGR MCP gateway.
